newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil weak, supply good.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil weak, supply good.

text.p: Supply of Russian fuel oil was still good in Europe on Monday and this had led to weaker prices, traders said.
Traders and brokers assessed Russian exports out of the Black Sea at 500-600,000 tonnes in January, compared with 900,000 tonnes in both November and December.
Dealers assessed January exports from the Black Sea at 200-250,000 tonnes, down by nearly a half from December.
A very prompt E-4 cargo was earlier heard offered at a discount to the mean/mean/mean but it was not known if this had been sold by the day's end.
